g.text: All 22,309 AMCB certificants. The strata partition the roster exactly; each loses one more property
than the one to its left. Bar labels are totals; boxed labels are the actively certified subset.
Every certificant here is a midwife: columns 1 and 2 differ by how the NPI was registered, not by profession.
What each linkage stratum has, and what it lacks
A name rule found at least
Properties are tested in order; a stratum holds a strict prefix of them, so the matrix is a staircase rather than a lattice. Candidates come from name rules
alone -- the roster carries no address and no date of birth -- searching a panel restricted to midwifery and nursing
taxonomies, so a certificant enumerated outside that panel is indistinguishable here from one who is absent.
Columns 3 and 4 carry an IDENTICAL pattern because they are the same thing recorded twice: both are class-5 candidates
held out of the cohort, 156 booked as held-out and 8 as ambiguous. The 8 differ only in having carried no middle initial
for the veto to act on. Reporting the 5,411 unresolved as one number hides causes as different as these.
Columns, left to right, as named in the source: matched · matched_nursing_taxonomy · candidate_class5_held_out_of_cohort ·
